decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits within the core cardboard range and costs little to keep listed, but it was not seen on the website in 2020 to 2021, which suggests its option value has faded and raises the risk of withdrawal.
The pegboard-back display uses existing capabilities at low holding cost, though four years without visible prominence means uncertainty has largely resolved toward modest value.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a core format with steady demand and negligible cost to maintain, so there is no case for abandoning it.
The eighth-pallet display rounds out the format range at minimal marginal cost and remains a useful option for smaller placements.

Demand for physical media in retail has kept declining through 2022, so the evidence now shows the value of this niche display is unlikely to be realized, and its resources are better used in the core business.
